en: Black‑and‑white view of a large, bustling market square filled with people in early‑20th‑century clothing. Numerous stalls and baskets are set up on cobblestones, with women in long skirts and head coverings selling produce. In the center of the square stands an ornate fountain topped with a statue. Surrounding the square are multi‑story townhouses with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, typical of central European architecture. Several shop signs are visible on the ground floors of the buildings.
